Considering 595 reviews, reviewers overwhelmingly had a great experience with this company. Customers frequently praise the exceptionally rapid response times and the dedicated support team that handles technical problems efficiently. Many consumers appreciate how reliable and intuitive the cloud platform is for building and managing projects smoothly. Some reviewers were not happy with account m anagement, noting that locked accounts involved tedious verification processes and strict security rules that delayed access. A few other people also felt that customer support could be unhelpful when dealing with restricted access, asking repeatedly for identification without providing clear explanations. results.content: Seems like there are two classes of complaints: 1) People receive spam from Digital Ocean. They run their own mail servers, but can't handle spam, and this is Digital Ocean's problem. (I stopped running my own mail server because of spam, but I don't blame DO for that.) 2) Fraudsters are prevented from signing up. I am sure VPS providers have a ton of people that don't pay for their service, so blocking them at signup time is probably mandatory. From some of the complaints, it sounds like people have their payment declined, DO contacts them, they still don't have money, and then DO cuts them off. That seems totally reasonable to me. I don't think a VPS provider could make money without some sort of strict account termination policy and anti-fraud analysis before signup.
